page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew-Latin dictionary entries on one page. Left column: entries from "requiescere" to "agitaveris". Right column: entries from "ad agitandum" to the Piel entry under the heading ה ס. No marginal notes. Page number at top left; running head at top of each column.

main_text.l: הֵנִיחַ requiescere facit ,
וְהָנִיחוֹתִי, vel &
requiem dedi , הָנִיחוּ
quietum reddiderunt ,
&c. præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 1. f & 3. pl. Rad. נוּחַ
הָנִיחַ requiem dato, vel da-re, Imper. vel Inf. Hiph. R. נוּחַ.
הֻנִּיחָה collocatur, Zach. 5. 11. est præt. comp. cum Jod ex Hiph. & Kibbutz ex Hoph. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. נוּחַ
לְהַנִּיס fugere fecit, ad fugandum, præt. 3. f. m. & Infin. Hiph. Rad. נָס
הֵנִיעָה movit ille, הֵנִיעָה illa, & הָנִיעַ moveto, & eos, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & fæm. ut & Imper. Hiph. f. m. aff. R. נוּעַ
הֵנִיף agitavit, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. נוּף.
הֵנִיפוּתִי agitavi, הֵנִיפוֹתָ agitaveris,
לְהַנִּיף ad agi-tandum, Jer. 30. 18. item
הֵנִיפָם agitare vos, & הָנִיפוּ agitate, &c. præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & i. & 2. f. m. ut & Infin. præf. & aff. & Imper. pl. m. Rad. נוּף.
וְהִנְעַשְׁתִּי & commovebo, præt. Hiph. 1. f. R. נוּעַ.
הֵנְעֲשׂוּ floruerunt, præt. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נָץ.
הַנְצֵל eripe te, Imper. Niph. f. m. R. נָצַל.
הַנָּקָה impunis esto, Imper. Niph. Rad. נָקָה.
הִנָּקֵם ultionem sume, vel sumere, Imper. vel Infin. Niph. Rad. נָקַם.
הִנָּתֵן dando, Infin. Niph. Rad. נָתַן.
הִנָּתֵק avulsi sunt, præt. Hoph. 3. pl. R. נָתַק.
main_text.head: ה ס
main_text.l: סַם vel סָם sile, Imper. Piel, apoc. (pro הַסֵּה,) f. m. &

page.notes: Hebrew transcription is approximate and not checked letter by letter; many vowel points and the Hebrew running head are doubtful. Left running head reading (הנ) and page number 86 are uncertain. Scan is faint and speckled, with show-through and damage in the left margin and at several line ends; the words "floruerunt" and "avulsi" are doubtful. The entry "ad agi-tandum" is hyphenated at the line end as printed.
